rationale: This materialization uses deterministic contract validation, rights/security/provider eligibility gates and explicit user engine/provider intent. It does not rank eligible engines/providers, choose a provider/model, authorize cloud execution, grant rights, place hardware, or mutate the editorial timeline autonomously. Decision Fabric is therefore not a decision authority for this scope.
